# N4V FOR WEBI

> N4V FOR WEBI is an extension suite for SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (Webi) developed by Need4Viz. It adds 60+ modern interactive visualizations, a full Geographic Information System (GIS), HTML5 export without a SAP BO license on the consumer side, and an AI layer providing Natural Language Query, Chart Recommendation, Automated Insights and Predictive Series — all directly inside SAP BusinessObjects, with no migration and no change management.

Need4Viz is a French software vendor founded in 2020, headquartered in Paris with a US office in Miami. It is an SAP Silver Partner, listed on the SAP Store and on AWS Marketplace, and used by more than 150,000 users across hundreds of organizations worldwide in healthcare, public sector, manufacturing, banking, retail, education and energy.

N4V FOR WEBI is a 4-in-1 solution composed of N4V Widgets, N4V Maps, N4V Publisher and N4V Intelligence, fully compatible with SAP BusinessObjects BI 4.2 (from SP8), BI 4.3 and the new BI 2025 release.
